name: March of the Honoured Dead
summary: Friendly Adeptus Custodes Walker units get +2" Move and +1 to Advance and Charge rolls.

name: Creeping Dread (Aura)
summary: During your opponent's Battle-shock step, enemy Psyker units or units below their starting strength within 12" of an Anathema Psykana model must take a Battle-shock test; units below half-strength subtract 1 from it instead.

name: Revered Companions
summary: Anathema Psykana units gain an aura giving nearby Custodes Feel No Pain 5+ against Psychic Attacks and mortal wounds; other Custodes units gain an aura adding 1 to the Hit roll of nearby Anathema Psykana attacks.

name: The Hammer Falls
summary: A friendly Adeptus Custodes Terminator unit that made an ingress move this turn can re-roll its charge roll.
